            MIKE AVERY’S NOTICE OF NEED FOR CORRECTION
              TO ATTACHMENT “B” TO ALJs’ ORDER NO. 30

        Pursuant to the ALJs’ ruling at the June 5, 2026 prehearing conference, Intervenor Mike
Avery (shown as Intervenor No. 540 on Attachment B) provides notice of the need for the two
following corrections to his entry on Attachment B:

        •   As described in his testimony filed on June 3, Mr. Avery lives on and is affected by
            Link K61 (not Link J32). Notwithstanding this correction to Attachment B, Mr.
            Avery reiterates his intention not to cross-examine any witness.
        •   Mr. Avery should be shown as being represented by the undersigned attorney.
